dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: I should have everything with me. But... No harm checking again, right? Sword, lamp, and...

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: ...Yes. It's crucial to be prepared for battle. We can't afford to forget anything.

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: On the battlefield, when you need something, whether it's a weapon, supplies, bandages, or potions, it must be within immediate reach.

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: I hate it when you could've done something, but end up failing because you weren't prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: I don't ever want to go through that again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wish you the best in your outing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you think that's a bit much to take with you?

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: Of course not. Internally, we have guidelines for gear to keep the overly cautious folks from stuffing their pockets with things they don't need.

dialogues.speaker: Zimin
dialogues.text: That said, while I always stick to the guidelines, I do tend to bring just a little extra when I can... After all, you never know when something might come in handy.
